NOVA 4 — key finding

Among the products in the dataset, vegan-identified products showed lower overall NOVA 4 prevalence than non-vegan-identified products. After Holm correction, statistically significant differences remained only in the salty snacks and sweet snacks categories.

SHAP nutritional contributions across NOVA groups

Six displayed features: energy, protein, saturated fat, sugars, fibre and salt

Interpreting SHAP violin plots

Positive SHAP values (e.g., +0.5 or greater) indicate that a nutrient contributes positively towards the model predicting a specific NOVA classification. The thickness of the violin represents the concentration of products with SHAP values within a particular range. Therefore, a thicker region on the positive side indicates that a greater concentration of products has nutrient contributions supporting the prediction of that NOVA category.
